data.name: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Join our Community


About the Game

Deadstick: Bush Pilot Simulator is a career-focused bush flying sim where skill, judgement and knowing the land get you home. Fly into unforgiving wilderness, deliver vital cargo, and help keep these rural communities alive - inspired by real bush pilots who do exactly that.
It's more considered and tactile than other flight sims. From white-knuckle landings, last-second decisions, and flights that went south, stories emerge naturally here

Because the best stories aren't about flawless flights. They're about surviving the bad ones.

Most days you're picking your way through mountain passes, watching weather roll in from the north, and delivering cargo to communities that depend on you. It's methodical, absorbing work and the smarter your preparation, the smoother your operation runs.

But the wilderness doesn't forgive poor judgment. When things go sideways, there's no reset button. Just you, your aircraft, and wherever you can find to put it down.

MISSIONS

Carve out your career as a bush pilot, taking on cargo deliveries, recon missions and dynamic jobs from a cast of colourful locals.

PILOT FOR HIRE

There's no head office and no boss - just you, a logbook, a fuel bill, and the next job. Choose what's worth your time, and reinvest your earnings in the gear and routes that pay off.

INVEST

Spend your earnings on upgrades, hangars, modifications and repairs. Invest in rural airports to improve their runways and add fuel pumps, cell towers and other facilities.Transform the island through the work you choose.

REPUTATION 

Earn a local reputation one flight at a time. Each airport tracks your safety, reliability, care and skill, unlocking more jobs. Just don't crash and burn at a major airport. Word gets around fast.

PILOT’S CORNER

Personalize your Pilot's Corner with memorabilia, trophies, and photos you've captured on your adventures.

Deadstick: Bush Pilot Simulator models the full reality of bush flying - from the aircraft systems you depend on to the terrain and weather that'll test every decision you make.

FLIGHT MODEL

From battery drain and weight distribution to stall behaviour and crosswind correction, every system behaves the way it should. Get it wrong and the aircraft will tell you.

COCKPIT

Study-level avionics, electrical loads, circuit breakers and instruments modelled in full. The better you know your aircraft, the better it'll serve you.

NAVIGATION

No GPS dependency. You're working with a map, compass, stopwatch and heading - the same tools real bush pilots have always relied on to find their way home.

WEATHER & TERRAIN

Updrafts and downdrafts, icing, thick cloud cover, grass strips, gravel and snow.

MODIFICATIONS

Access hangars to upgrade your aircraft into the ultimate STOL workhorse. Swap props for a faster cruise, enlarge the tyres for rough terrain, and tune the plane that suits the routes you fly.

DAMAGE MODEL

Worn tyres, failing systems, structural damage from a landing that was too heavy or a route that asked too much. Deal with what you've got, manage it home, or deadstick it down and hope the ground is kind.

We think you'll love Deadstick: Bush Pilot Simulator if you enjoy…

Euro Truck Simulator 2, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, X-Plane, DCS World, Aerofly, American Truck Simulator, SnowRunner, Farming Simulator 25, PowerWash Simulator 2, RoadCraft, MudRunner, BeamNG.drive, Transport Fever 2, Pacific Drive, Death Stranding, Cartel Pilots Wanted.

data.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7600K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are subject to changes during optimization process.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
